title: Control reply and correlation

commands.report: 262 unit tests pass; control-replies/correlations suites cover W01/W02/W12/W16

tests: W01 a control reply ignores route/quiet and lands on the inbound channel
W01 control requires controlEnabled and a usable reply context
W01 an expired reply context reports CONTEXT_EXPIRED instead of guessing
W01 an uncertain send records an uncertain-effect receipt and never claims success
a channel without controlReply capability is UNSUPPORTED, not a fake send
W02 a correlation is reserved before submit and binds to the started turn
W02 two principals cannot share one session reply path
W02 restart cancels a reserved correlation and marks an active one uncertain
W16 revoking a principal cancels only that principal live correlations
validationNote: Re-validated in handoff session after R08
